write_up: Your resume points toward Staff Accountant work: you bring senior accounting experience from Minh Phat Trading Company and current accounts payable work at Bayou Industrial Supply. A recruiter can see the work and its scale, though a few lines leave your part in closing and audit work open to question.

The strongest model is your month-end closing line at Minh Phat. It gives the old and new timelines and names the checklist and template you made. Your current role also grounds the work with around 400 vendor invoices a month in QuickBooks.

Let's start with what you help the controller do at month end, then add the work behind your ledger, team and audit responsibilities at Minh Phat. Those details can connect your current payables work to the broader accounting work you're seeking.

fit.note: Your current payables work and earlier general ledger responsibilities give you a basis for both jobs named in your profile. The closing and audit details can make the broader accounting experience easier to carry into a Staff Accountant application.
